label: Grades maximum from distinct causal possession
meaning: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. The initial exceeding bearer has r by the retained more-such-bearer premise. At each exceeded bearer, exceeded-is-caused gives a distinct cause; possession alone supplies its actuality for induction. Well-foundedness and excluded middle yield a weak maximal bearer, without uniqueness, greatestness or causality of that maximum. Supports the quarta via root-route node under explicit premises; no premise warrant or global minimality is claimed.
